A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MBOK research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–J. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v3 reports original MBOK perplexity, zero-shot accuracy, ablations, generated examples and GPU latency measurements in Section 6 and Appendix G.

after.justification: v5 retains the original MBOK benchmark, ablation, generation and latency results in Section 6 and Appendix G.

M1.justification: The Boolean optimizer, multiple-kernel architecture, successive SVID initialization, distillation losses and kernel-allocation procedure are unchanged, including their appendix algorithms and code examples.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same WikiText2 and C4 data, zero-shot tasks including BoolQ, PIQA, HellaSwag, Winogrande and ARC, and generation prompts. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main experiments and appendix comparisons. This includes the binarization and quantization baselines in Tables 2–4 and 7, and QuIP, ShiftAddLLM, AWQ, BitStack, DB-LLM, QUIP# and QTIP in Appendix G.

E3.justification: Section 6 retains 2048-token sequences, three training epochs, batch size 8 and the same learning-rate schedules. Model configurations, bit budgets, evaluation metrics and Appendix G.11 latency procedures are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The kernel-count and optimization studies, KD-loss comparisons, KD/no-KD ablation, scaling-value analysis, convergence plots and SVID-versus-random initialization study are identical. The generation case studies are also retained.

E5.justification: Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds or uncertainty intervals. The existing distribution analysis, including the Kolmogorov–Smirnov statistics and density estimates in Figure 14, is unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results, plotted curves and generated examples are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 2 retains two-kernel LLaMA-7B perplexities of 6.83 on WikiText2 and 8.53 on C4; Table 13 retains the 0.04987 ms latency and 8.70× speedup for the 13824×5120 layer.

T1.justification: The Boolean calculus in Appendix A, SVID propositions and proofs in Section 4.1 and Appendix D, kernel-allocation mathematics and Appendix F complexity analysis are unchanged. The new author-credit statement adds no mathematical result or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion preserve the same claims about direct Boolean finetuning, successive SVID, flexible kernel allocation and accuracy/efficiency. The new author-contribution statement attributes existing contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of last-kernel finetuning, distillation, scaling changes and vector-quantization comparisons are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitation concerning the inability to evaluate native Boolean accelerators.

D1.justification: Implementation examples, hyperparameters, GPU specifications, implementation links and the reproducibility statement are unchanged. The new acknowledgement of infrastructure support supplies no additional technical setup or access information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the appendix discussions of prior methods and the cited-work set are unchanged. The bibliography reflows across pages without adding or removing references or revising research positioning.

P1.justification: v5 adds Acknowledgements and an Author Contributions Statement after Section 7, identifying support and each author's responsibilities. It also expands the first-page label from 'corresponding' to 'corresponding author'; scientific prose and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Page 10 spacing changes to accommodate the new statements, and references begin on page 11 instead of page 10 and reflow through page 16. Figures and table designs are retained; the entire appendix is visually identical.

improvement.justification: v5 clarifies author roles and acknowledges feedback and infrastructure support. These limited credit disclosures and layout adjustments leave the scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs, limitations and reproducibility information unchanged, including all appendices. They produce no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
